content:
Daily scratchpad - Customer Success (Olivia)
Date: 2026-03-04

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Prep deck for Acme Corp QBR (Fri 03/06) - finalize slides + 2 backup slides on latency/cost improvements
    - action: pull 90/95/99 latency numbers from console for last quarter (Maya to confirm)
    - action: include recent spend optimization notes (Ethan had the quantization pilot numbers)
- [ ] Renewal outreach: NovaHealth (renewal 03/18) - confirm PO status and legal review cadence
    - note: finance asked for updated SOW; I need to attach the revised pricing table (see linked CON-7892)
- [ ] Support follow-ups: resolve remaining items for BetaBank ticket JIRA-CS-4123
    - root cause analysis draft due EOD; escalate to eng if ETA slips >48h

Quick account notes / reminders
- Acme Corp (QBR): 3 major wins to highlight: improved 99p latency by ~12%, 30% token cost reduction via KV cache, added dedicated routing for eu-west
- NovaHealth: procurement request sent 02/25, legal doing redlines; expect 1-2 week lag. Keep weekly cadence until signed.
- BetaBank: intermittent OOMs under peak traffic; SRE deployed hotfix 03/02 but still seeing 2% error rate on long-tail prompts. Follow-up with serving-runtime team.

Draft QBR outline (super-rough)
1) Quick context + ARR / usage summary (1 slide) - include headline metrics
2) Performance story (2 slides): latency percentiles, throughput trends, optimizations applied
3) Cost story (1 slide): per-token $ trend, batching/cache wins, projection with Dedicated plan
4) Reliability & incidents (1 slide): incident timelines, mitigations, SLA health
5) Roadmap & asks (1 slide): planned model upgrades, private deployment options, ask for feedback & updated forecast
6) Appendix: detailed metrics, quantization pilot results, SLO definitions

Questions I need answered before deck final
- Can eng provide a short blurb (2-3 sentences) on the quantization pilot benefits by EOD Thu? (ping @eng-serving-runtime)
- Does finance have the final committed discount tiers for Dedicated renewals? (Ethan to confirm)

Outbound messages to send today
- NovaHealth: short note asking for PO update + offer 30m sync next Wed (template saved in Confluence)
- BetaBank: acknowledge we're working on RCA and provide interim mitigation steps (include throttling suggestion)
- Acme: one-line reminder about QBR time slot + pre-read link (send once deck draft ready)

To-do (personal)
- [ ] Draft Acme pre-read (first pass) - target Wed lunchtime
- [ ] Update renewal tracker spreadsheet with NovaHealth status (finance column)
- [ ] Write RCA draft for BetaBank and share with SRE/serving-runtime
- [ ] Prep demo clip showing 99p latency improvement for QBR (maybe 30s screen recording)

Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider proposing a short pilot to Acme for Dedicated burst capacity during month-end to show tail-latency stability
- If NovaHealth legal asks for data residency proof, link to Private deployment docs (CON-5010) and CC security@redwood

Unresolved/risks
- If finance delays SOW, NovaHealth may postpone renewal; escalate to AM lead after 2 missed check-ins
- BetaBank persistent OOMs could materially harm renewal negotiations if not fixed before QBR

Links & refs
- QBR template: CON-7892
- Renewal tracker: google-sheet-id: 1zXabc... (in team drive)
- BetaBank ticket: JIRA-CS-4123
- Serving-runtime slack channel: #eng-serving-runtime

End of day notes (placeholder)
- Will fill with outcomes / who I talked to / updated next steps

Quick log (timestamps)
- 09:10 - checked console metrics for Acme (prelim numbers look good)
- 10:00 - sync with Maya re: slides (assigned latency chart)
- 11:30 - emailed finance re: NovaHealth pricing
- 14:00 - triage w/ SRE on BetaBank, asked for heap dump (waiting)
